name: hapt
paper_title: Transition-Aware Human Activity Recognition Using Smartphones
authors: Jorge L. Reyes-Ortiz, Luca Oneto, Albert Samà, Xavier Parra, Davide Anguita
license: CC BY 4.0 (dataset, per UCI ML Repository). Paper: Elsevier, closed access.
notes: Canonical paper for the HAPT dataset (a.k.a. 'Smartphone-Based Recognition of Human Activities and Postural Transitions', UCI ID 341). This is the transition-aware extension of the original 2013 ESANN UCI HAR dataset by the same SmartLab (UNIGE/DIBRIS) + CETpD (UPC) group. 30 subjects aged 19-48. Samsung Galaxy S II smartphone worn on the WAIST. 3-axial linear acceleration + 3-axial angular velocity (accelerometer + gyroscope) sampled at 50 Hz. Signals pre-processed with noise filters, windowed in 2.56 s sliding windows with 50% overlap (128 readings/window). 12 activity classes: 6 basic (WALKING, WALKING_UPSTAIRS, WALKING_DOWNSTAIRS, SITTING, STANDING, LAYING) + 6 postural transitions (STAND_TO_SIT, SIT_TO_STAND, SIT_TO_LIE, LIE_TO_SIT, STAND_TO_LIE, LIE_TO_STAND). Includes both raw inertial signals and a 561-feature time/frequency vector per window. NOTE: no open-access PDF of the Neurocomputing paper exists (confirmed closed via Semantic Scholar; ScienceDirect returns 403 to bots; no arXiv/UPCommons preprint of this specific paper), so a landing page (UCI dataset page) was saved as webpage.html instead of paper.pdf. UCI dataset DOI: 10.24432/C54G7M.
